description: Document structure and metadata elements illegal in React Native
reason: React Native has no DOM concept - these are web document structure elements

alternatives.html: App root component with React Native navigation
alternatives.head: No equivalent - metadata handled by platform
alternatives.body: App root component or main container
alternatives.title: StatusBar component or navigation title
alternatives.link: No equivalent - stylesheets not used in React Native
alternatives.meta: No equivalent - handled by app manifest
